messages:
maya: Quick async check-in — SDKs / quickstarts / sample app
What I did: finished python SDK quickstart draft (PR #423). Added example usage and minimal auth section.
Blockers: macOS wheel build failing on CI at `pip install .` step — binary wheel error in manylinux tags.
Today: fix CI, polish sample app auth flow, open docs fixes for auth and troubleshooting.

aj: I saw that failure earlier. Looks like setup.cfg tags are missing the manylinux2014 spec. Try adding `--plat-name=manylinux2014_x86_64` to the wheel build or switch to building a pure wheel with `pip wheel --no-binary :all:` for now. Also check the C extension flags.

sam: pinged on your sample app PR, left a couple comments about the auth flow & README. Env vars could be clearer. :eyes:

alex: I can take the docs fixes after CI is green. Happy to merge the auth docs and run the site build if you want.

ci-bot: Build failed for job devex-macos-wheels (link: https://ci.example.com/builds/1789) — wheel build error: `error: invalid manylinux tag`. Full log attached to the job.

maya: thanks @aj — pushed a small change to setup.cfg and retriggered the macos pipeline. Updated PR description with reproduction steps and error logs.

aj: :thumbsup: If mac still flakes, we can skip mac wheel job temporarily to unblock docs merges and file a tech-debt ticket to re-enable proper mac builds.

sam: lgtm on the sample app otherwise. Small nit: rename REDWOOD_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY in README so users don't get confused.

maya: noted, will rename env var and add a migration note + changelog entry. Aiming to merge by EOD.

alex: if you want I can file the tech-debt ticket and link it to the PR.

maya: please do, that'd help track follow-up. Thanks everyone!
